Variants.Content: High kingship depends on recognition, gifts and protection. Roman wealth can increase standing, but lost households bring demands for an account.
Gartnait relies on recognition, gifts and protection. Military recognition also rests on rewards and relief; a title needs willing action. Household losses in raids bring demands for an account.
